decisionsTitle: The new look's accent is the club's setting: presets and a typed colour, AA held
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-11.** Phase 1 (§708) took decision 1's default: a hot-pink accent beside the logo blue, as fixed tokens in `src/theme/brand.ts`. The calendar's mock-up wears a blue accent instead. Asked which to keep, he answered: «this should be a configuration in the theme». This amends §708 (the tokens, the pink `primary`, the setting) and decision 1 of §692; §711 stands: the logo is the club's blue under every accent. On a phone each option's preview wraps above its name rather than squeezing it.

**Decision — the choices.** «Setări» → «Aspect» → «Aspectul nou» gains a second group in the same form, «Culoarea de accent», with four radios:

- «Roz», the default: phase 1's tokens, unchanged. A club that never chose an accent sees exactly what it saw.
- «Albastru»: the club's blue as today's look wears it — `COLOR.blue` as the hot shade, `COLOR.blueInk` for the words, the hero's tint for the band — and one deeper step for a pressed button.
- «Portocaliu»: the club's secondary orange. By day the orange itself is 2.6 : 1 on the page, too light to carry words, so its shades walk towards brown until they do; after dark it is kept as it is.
- «Personalizat»: a colour typed as `#rrggbb` (a missing `#` and spaces are forgiven), with the browser's colour picker beside the box.

The three presets are `LOOK_ACCENT` in `brand.ts`, the only file allowed a hex value (§694). Each preset, and each typed colour, is four shades by day and four after dark: `accent` (the mark, a rule, a large word), `accentInk` (the words, MUI's `primary.main` under the look), `accentDeep` (a pressed button) and `accentTint` (a pale band, the weekly runs' chip).

**Decision — the server derives the shades.** `modules/appearance/domain/accent-shades.ts` is pure arithmetic with no colour literal. It walks the typed colour towards black by day, or towards white after dark, in 1 % steps, and stops at the first step that keeps each shade's rule:

- `accent`: AA (4.5 : 1) as text on the page and on a card, and the words on its fill at AA too (white by day, the dark page after dark).
- `accentInk`: at least 15 % further. By day it is no lighter than the muted ink. §488 already holds the muted ink at AA on every page tint the club may choose, a typed one included, so the accent's words hold on every tint too. In either scheme it reaches 7 : 1 against the card.
- `accentDeep`: at least 15 % further again and a clear step past `accentInk`: deeper by day, lighter after dark, the order the blues already have.
- `accentTint`: the card colour with 10 % of the accent by day (14 % after dark), lessened until the body's ink, the muted ink and `accentInk` all read on it at AA.

A colour that already keeps a rule is kept as typed, so the club's own colour is what the page shows wherever it can be. Only two things are refused, each in words: a value that is not `#rrggbb`, and a grey (channels within 40 of each other) — a grey accent reads as body text, and a link would stop looking like one (`SITE_ACCENT_TOO_GREY`). The typed accent reuses §488's contrast helpers (`tint-contrast.ts`) without changing them. The backoffice island (`CustomAccentOption`) draws the same shades live from the same function and writes their values out; the server decides. A stored typed colour that would be refused today is read as the pink, with the switch kept.

**Decision — storage and audit.** The accent lives in the same `platform_settings` row, `siteLook`, as `{ on, accent: "pink" | "blue" | "orange" }` or `{ on, accent: "custom", hex }`. A row written before this, `{ on }`, reads as the pink, and a save that sends no accent keeps the one in force. No migration is needed. The audit row `site_look.changed` keeps its `{ from, to }`, and adds `accentFrom` and `accentTo` (a preset's name, or `custom #rrggbb`) only when the accent changed, so a flip of the switch reads as it always did. It stays the Administrator's alone (`canManageClubSettings`, asserted at the page, the action and the service), behind §384's question, and a save expires the public cache's settings (§549).

**Decision — how everything follows it.** The layout's one unlayered stylesheet (§708) is now written from the accent in force. It sets MUI's own `--mui-palette-primary-*` variables and their channels (main `accentInk`, light `accent`, dark `accentDeep`, the words on the fill the platform's), plus one variable of ours, `--br-accent-tint` (`LOOK_ACCENT_TINT` in `theme/look.ts`), for the one shade MUI's palette has no slot for. Both are set light and dark under the look's scope. The home page's bands (`HOME_BAND_SX`) and the weekly runs' tag (`RunTag`) now read that variable and `primary.main` instead of naming the pink's tokens, so one rule serves both schemes and every accent. A test refuses `COLOR.accent*` anywhere in `src/` outside the theme's two files. The variable is not a theme-wide family: the theme still reads MUI's variables only, which is what §708 refused to change.

**The design page.** `/admin/design` → «Aspectul nou» keeps today's look and the new one side by side in the default pink (the page reads no setting). Under them it draws every preset in miniature, by day and after dark, with its four shades' values. «Culori» adds the blue and orange presets' pairs to the AA table.

**Held by tests.** `tests/unit/appearance/look-accent.test.ts` holds every preset and 432 typed colours across the colour wheel (every 15° of hue, four saturations, five lightnesses, the greys taken out) to AA on the ten pairs a scheme the look draws with the accent, to the order of the shades, and to the words' shade being no lighter than the muted ink and at AA on every page tint. It also holds that the pink is phase 1's tokens, that the orange is the derivation's answer for the club's orange, and the refusals, the parsing and the stylesheet. `tests/integration/appearance/site-look.test.ts` covers the saves, the audit, the refusals and the unchanged row. `tests/unit/appearance/site-look-accent-panel.test.ts` renders the form in both languages. `tests/e2e/look-accent.spec.ts` walks the screen: a preset and a typed colour worn by a public page and never by the backoffice, and a grey refused in words.

**Refused.**

- A colour picker with no presets: the club asked for its colours, and a preset is one press.
- Refusing a typed colour that is too light or too dark: the server can always derive readable shades, so it does, and says which.
- A free colour without the AA derivation: whatever is typed gets shades that hold AA, or is refused in words.
- A second theme object: the accent rides on MUI's own primary variables under the look's scope, one theme.
- A second setting row for the accent: the look and its accent are one choice, saved by one press, so the club never saves a look in an accent it has not seen.
- A `--br-accent-*` family for all four shades: MUI's primary already carries three of them.
- Reading the setting in a component.
- Letting the accent reach the logo, the backoffice, the emails, the PDFs, the race numbers or the share cards.

**For phase 4 (the calendar, on its own branch).** Its pink — the active chip, the eyebrow, the button, the weekly runs' colour — follows the club's accent once it wears `primary.*` and `LOOK_ACCENT_TINT` instead of `COLOR.accent*`. Since this change, the guard above refuses the latter.
changelogLine: - **The new look's accent colour is the club's choice** — «Setări» → «Aspect» → «Aspectul nou» → «Culoarea de accent»: pink (the default), the club's blue, the club's orange, or a colour you type. The site works out the readable shades by day and at night, at AA, and shows them before you save. The logo stays blue, and the backoffice, emails and PDFs do not change. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Under «Aspectul nou» the accent is the club's setting: pink (the default, phase 1's tokens), blue, orange, or a typed `#rrggbb` that is not a grey. For every preset and every typed colour, the four shades by day and after dark clear WCAG AA on every pair the look draws with the accent; the shade that carries words is no lighter than the muted ink, so it reads on every page tint; and a pressed button's shade is a step deeper by day and lighter after dark. A public page wears the accent only through MUI's primary and the band's variable, never the backoffice (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Only an Administrator saves the accent of «Aspectul nou», asserted at the page, the action and the service. A grey or a value that is not a colour is refused with nothing written; the audit row names the accent only when it changed; and a row written before the accent existed reads as the pink (2026-10-11, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
